title: Session management based network slice data rate limitation control

entities.name: Network slice data rate limitation control
entities.description: Procedure performed by serving PLMN or HPLMN to monitor and control the total data rate of established PDU sessions per network slice for S-NSSAI(s) subject to limitation control.

entities.name: UE-Slice-MBR management
entities.description: Procedure performed by serving PLMN or HPLMN to manage Slice-Maximum Bit Rate per UE for S-NSSAI to which PDU session is allocated.

entities.name: PDU session establishment procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing PDU sessions on a network slice associated with an S-NSSAI.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information identifying a network slice.

entities.name: Maximum data rate exceeded
entities.description: Condition where the maximum data rate of PDU sessions on a network slice associated with an S-NSSAI has been exceeded.

entities.name: UE-Slice-MBR exceeded
entities.description: Condition where the UE-Slice-MBR for the UE and S-NSSAI to which the PDU session is allocated is exceeded.

entities.name: SMF rejects PDU session establishment request
entities.description: Behavior where SMF may reject PDU session establishment request using S-NSSAI based congestion control when data rate limits are exceeded.

entities.name: Not applicable for emergency services
entities.description: Condition where network slice data rate limitation control can be not applicable for S-NSSAI(s) used for emergency services or priority services based on operator policy.

entities.name: PCF
entities.description: Policy Control Function that performs network slice data rate limitation control and UE-Slice-MBR management.

relations.description: Network slice data rate limitation control applies to S-NSSAI(s) subject to limitation control.
When maximum data rate is exceeded during PDU session establishment, SMF may reject the request.
When UE-Slice-MBR is exceeded during PDU session establishment, SMF may reject the request.
Maximum data rate exceeded condition is checked during PDU session establishment procedure.
UE-Slice-MBR exceeded condition is checked during PDU session establishment procedure.
Network slice data rate limitation control may not apply to emergency services S-NSSAIs based on operator policy.
PCF performs network slice data rate limitation control.
